instr:
# Waveterm: diagnosing thirty behaviour regressions without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything that has been noticed from the outside, written up as what someone did and what came back. Nothing about the surrounding software changed and nothing about the stored data changed: the same actions that used to be answered correctly are now answered wrongly, and in several places something that used to be refused is waved through or something that used to succeed is turned away.

Picking up a saved assistant conversation goes wrong in several ways. Asking such a conversation for the recorded arguments of an invocation that is still pending, by its reference key, returns nothing at all, even though the conversation plainly holds that invocation complete with its name and its argument object. Marking that same invocation finished by the same reference key leaves its entry exactly as it was; the update lands on every entry except the one that was asked for. Adding a follow-up message to a conversation that names the very same assistant variant as the message already stored is rejected as a mismatch, as though the two names differed. And choosing an outside inference service for conversations leaves the request settings blank afterwards: the endpoint, the flavour of the wire format, and the name of the secret holding the access token all come back empty rather than the values that service requires.
